title: Final scientific rule authority is not singularly resolved
recommended_action: Choose and version one final authority contract or a verified bridge; add conformance and stale-authority rejection tests without rewriting PILOT V1.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Future results could be attributed to a verifier or rule authority that did not govern execution.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Two partially overlapping authority planes and several entrypoints remain costly to audit.
claim_risk_if_ignored: The verified-rule construction contribution needs one explicit final method identity.
verification_after_action: Contract matrix; projection/rebinding tests; runtime authorization negative tests; exact authority receipt.

title: D1 lacks a durable pre-label prediction gate
recommended_action: For VALIDATION V2, atomically persist, close, reopen/replay, authorize labels only after byte validation, and recheck bytes after metrics.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: A future final study would have weaker evidence against post-label mutation than D0 and D2.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Nested dictionaries remain mutable and there is no atomic persist-close-reopen state transition.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Pilot wording must remain qualified; expanded results need the stronger gate.
verification_after_action: Synthetic state-machine and mutation tests plus custody receipt; zero label access before durable authorization.

title: Validation, policy-selection, and final held-out roles are not frozen
recommended_action: Preregister validation and final-test roles, select/freeze any fusion policy on validation, and prohibit post-final tuning.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Policy choice on final outcomes would invalidate independent confirmation and generalization claims.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: A new authorization, custody sequence, and immutable split-role manifest are required.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Current results remain pilot-only; final claims require a new one-way study.
verification_after_action: Pre-result protocol hash, split-role manifest, one-way access ledger, and final policy receipt.

title: Attack-event scope and inferential unit are not established
recommended_action: Freeze event-unit construction, overlap rule, evaluation scope, and an inference plan appropriate to the available dependence structure; do not manufacture independence.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Tiny or dependent units cannot support broad superiority or stable inference.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: No code defect; the event and inference contract must be preregistered.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Descriptive pilot results are usable, but inferential/general claims are not.
verification_after_action: Preregistered event manifest and analysis plan before outcomes.

title: Construction failures can collapse into no_rule
recommended_action: Persist explicit no_rule, provider, parse, rejection, non-repairable, retrieval, and budget outcomes with faithful call accounting.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Arm success, safety refusal, and system failure rates can be misclassified.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Outcome taxonomy and persisted reason codes are non-conformant.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Blocks a credible Agentic/construction comparison, not Rule-only detection evaluation.
verification_after_action: Negative transition matrix; no failure class accepted as no_rule; frozen three-case interpretation retained historically.

title: GDN internal Top-5 can spend a slot on self
recommended_action: Correct the mask order in a new version or preregister an explicit old-versus-corrected ablation before EXP-01.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Graph-ranking and masking conclusions may depend on an unintended neighbor-budget convention.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Pre-Top-K mask order is not aligned with the documented candidate policy.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Does not invalidate the 144-pair closure or frozen pilot, but blocks a clean GDN contribution test.
verification_after_action: Synthetic diagonal/mask/top-k tests and versioned candidate receipts.

title: Graph-Guided scientific contribution is unvalidated
recommended_action: Preregister seed and split stability, GDN-only confirmed yield, functional masking, and Top-20 sensitivity/justification.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Candidate presence alone cannot support a useful graph-guidance contribution.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: The authoritative backend identity and analysis contract must remain frozen.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Graph-Guided stays provisional and should be removed from the headline contribution if EXP-01 is negative or inconclusive.
verification_after_action: Frozen EXP-01 protocol and contribution decision table.

title: Agentic feedback benefit is not identifiable in the pilot
recommended_action: Freeze provider/model/prompt/evidence hashes, temperature, budgets, retries, repeated generations, and construction metrics; never inject artificial failures merely to activate feedback.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Implemented capability cannot be interpreted as feedback benefit.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Exact deterministic LLM replay is impossible; traceable repeated sampling and custody are feasible.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Agentic remains conditional; no observed action means no demonstrated benefit.
verification_after_action: Budget/custody audit and predefined conclusion rule when feedback remains unused.

title: Expanded detection lacks a stronger multivariate baseline
recommended_action: Identify and preregister at least one stronger multivariate detector before final EXP-04 results; apply the same label and metric custody.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Comparison only to PCA-SPE cannot support competitive detector claims.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: A new frozen detector implementation and equivalent custody adapter are required.
claim_risk_if_ignored: PCA-SPE may remain the transparent reference, but final detection claims need at least one stronger baseline.
verification_after_action: Frozen baseline identity, hyperparameter-selection role, prediction receipt, and common metric handoff.

title: Evaluated V4 trace is not connected to canonical explanation
recommended_action: Materialize a continuous-step trace from the selected runtime authority and bind a deterministic renderer to it.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Explanation fidelity cannot be evaluated against a trace that the evaluated runtime did not produce.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: A versioned authority-bound trace/renderer bridge is missing.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Blocks EXP-05 structural fidelity only; does not block EXP-04 detection.
verification_after_action: Field-level trace equivalence, no-new-variable/number checks, outcome and provenance fidelity tests.

title: Fresh-machine reproducibility is incomplete
recommended_action: After ARCH-011, build and rehearse a sanitized environment/entrypoint/data-manifest capsule before held-out access.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: A final held-out run could depend on unrecorded environment behavior.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Portable environment and data-manifest bindings are incomplete.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Does not block read-only audits or early protocol preparation; should precede authoritative held-out execution.
verification_after_action: Independent clean-machine rehearsal with exact public receipts and zero scientific outcome access.

title: Metric portability and final comparison lineage are partial
recommended_action: Version the common metric adapter, enforce sampling/file identity at its boundary, and bind the cross-arm table to source and inputs.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: A new multi-file or irregular-time study could silently violate the frozen metric assumptions.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: The final comparison adapter is not fully source-reproducible.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Current per-arm pilot metrics remain traceable; final reporting needs a versioned common adapter.
verification_after_action: Synthetic multi-file/gap/boundary tests and comparison-artifact source receipt.

title: Split enforcement and entrypoint conformance are distributed
recommended_action: Add a static entrypoint-to-split-role and artifact-authority conformance map for VALIDATION V2.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: No bypass was found; future expansion could introduce one without a uniform conformance check.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Distributed grants and entrypoints increase maintenance and audit cost.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Hardening is valuable but not a reason to refactor frozen pilot paths.
verification_after_action: All scientific entrypoints mapped; unauthorized roles and stale grants rejected synthetically.

title: train3 has two disclosed normal-only roles
recommended_action: Disclose the dual role; separate only if the future preregistered split design can do so without weakening evidence.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: It creates cross-method coupling but no verified label leakage.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Separating it would require a new split and is not automatically worth the scope.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Transparent disclosure is sufficient unless a future protocol has enough data to separate roles.
verification_after_action: Current-facing method and limitation wording checked.

title: Terminology and object-level claims need continuous control
recommended_action: Apply the GAP-000 wording guide to current-facing RCC, thesis, and professor material; do not rewrite frozen history.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Overstatement can invalidate claim interpretation even when implementation is sound.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: No scientific code fix is required.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Use non-causal, pilot-only, authority-specific wording and conditional contribution labels.
verification_after_action: Claim-registry and terminology lint against current-facing outputs.

title: Cause of D1's high normal FAR is not decomposed
recommended_action: Do not invent a cause or tune on final data; analyze only under a separately frozen development protocol if EXP-04 needs it.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Operational utility remains unvalidated; the descriptive metric is still valid.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: No remediation is required merely to preserve the negative pilot observation.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Can remain an explicit limitation and future failure-analysis topic.
verification_after_action: Limitation and utility boundary retained in claims.

title: Human usefulness of explanations is unvalidated
recommended_action: Limit EXP-05 to structural fidelity unless the user and professor explicitly make human evaluation thesis-essential.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Only a human-usefulness claim is blocked.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: No code defect follows from the absence of a human study.
claim_risk_if_ignored: May remain a limitation because the core contribution is verified construction/governance.
verification_after_action: No human-benefit wording without a separately approved study.

title: Relation-specific numeric criteria are not scientifically optimal
recommended_action: Preregister common fixed versus relation-specific normal-only criteria; keep any LLM-proposed values diagnostic and non-authoritative.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: Traceability does not prove the selected relation-specific values improve construction or runtime behavior.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: No hidden runtime mismatch was found; the gap is comparative evidence.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Numeric authority can be described as normal-derived, not optimized or superior.
verification_after_action: Frozen alternatives, selection metric, normal-only derivation, and authority receipts.

title: Runtime LLM and broader relation extensions are not needed for this thesis
recommended_action: Do not implement for the master's thesis; retain only the documented no-outcome-leakage boundary.
scientific_risk_if_ignored: None for the frozen R0/D1 thesis question.
engineering_risk_if_ignored: Implementing them now would expand attack surface and scope.
claim_risk_if_ignored: Defer unless core validation later creates a specific need.
verification_after_action: EXP-06 remains NOT_REQUIRED unless explicitly authorized.
